keyTerms.title: Embodied & Interactive Play
keyTerms.description: I love exploring how technology changes perception, and how perception, in turn, shapes our bodies. I bring this curiosity into interactive games and wearable devices, connecting play with bodily experience.

keyTerms.title: Women’s Health
keyTerms.description: I draw on my own experiences with period pain and trauma to make room for stories that are often left unspoken. I use games and visual narratives to explore what care can feel like.

keyTerms.title: Feminist Community Building
keyTerms.description: I care about the challenges women face and am committed to building communities for women. I founded and manage the Women’s Gaming Club at UCI, with 300 Discord members. As FemTech Associate Director at the Harvard Griffin GSAS Business Club (HGGBC), I connect with outstanding women leaders and invite them to speak at Harvard.

projectGroups.name: My Projects
projectGroups.intro: Health, bodies, and immersive worlds. Start here.

projects.name: Just Keep Breathing
projects.desc: My capstone project for the Media, Medicine, and Health (MMH) program at Harvard Medical School is a visual novel controlled through breathing using a Vernier Go Direct respiration belt. It tells the story of my own experiences with post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) and intimate partner violence (IPV).

projects.name: Her Cycle
projects.type: Visual Novel Video Game / Women’s Health
projects.desc: A visual novel about a girl’s menstrual cycle, unfolding across its four phases. Inspired by my own experiences with period pain, it explores the often-unspoken struggles that girls face. To watch the trailer or download and play, follow the details link.

projects.name: Exhibition of Medieval Women's Daily Life
projects.desc: A virtual exhibition built in Minecraft that challenges stereotypes reducing medieval women to witches. It highlights their many contributions to medicine, baking, brewing, and herbal practices, offering a fuller picture of their everyday lives and expertise.

projects.name: My Little Planet
projects.desc: A browser-based ecosystem learning game for K–12 science education.

projectGroups.name: Class Projects
projectGroups.intro: Experiments in AR, games, and playful interaction.

projects.name: MIT MANUS Comic
projects.desc: I interviewed Neville Hogan about MIT-MANUS to explore how robotic arms and games can support stroke rehabilitation. I turned the interview into a science comic, which was collected by the MIT Museum.

projects.name: Pocket Pixie
projects.desc: An AR-guided app that breaks daily tasks into small steps with emotional support, designed for users with executive function challenges such as ADHD.

projects.name: The Brew Beneath
projects.type: UCI Capstone / Visual Novel & Café Management
projects.desc: A UCI capstone game combining a visual novel with café management. Each night, you prepare coffee orders for monster customers, befriend them, and uncover a shocking conspiracy lurking beneath the town.

projects.name: Finding James
projects.desc: Find your boyfriend in the park after a quarrel. A silly game about searching and making up. This was a homework assignment on NavMesh navigation and baking.

projects.name: Falling Guy
projects.desc: A class project inspired by NS-SHAFT.
